08080 shaman {sha:-man'}

字根型; TWOT - 2410; 動詞

欽定本 - wax fat 3, make fat 1, became fat 1; 5

1) 變胖
   1a) (Qal) 變胖
   1b) (Hiphil) 使之肥胖, 顯出肥胖
record.edic_text:
08080 shaman {shaw-man'}

a primitive root; TWOT - 2410; v

AV - wax fat 3, make fat 1, became fat 1; 5

1) to be or become fat, grow fat
   1a) (Qal) fat (subst)
   1b) (Hiphil) to make fat, show fatness
